_what: CONTENT DELTA — Amendment 8 §C's 71 audience values, plus outside-review corrections. THIS CLOSES THE DELIBERATE RED SUITE.
_cutFrom: the 173-class state as merged in PR #69, read from the source.
_howToApply: Append the two arrays, then REPLACE every entry in `_modifiedCareCategories` and `_modifiedClasses` by id.

_audienceDistribution.note: `both` at 41% — higher than the schedule's 23%, and the reason is real: engine care is object-specific, and whether a household clears its own gutters depends on the house rather than on the task. **The value that made category grain survivable is doing more work here than in the file it was borrowed from.**

_theOutsideReviewInOneLine: Three prompts went out, each pointed at a different failure mode, and **all three came back distinct** — completeness, correctness, and region. **The regional pass is the most valuable of the three for this business** and the only one whose findings could not have come from general knowledge. Two of its items converge with the completeness pass by a different route — a sulphur treatment class and an outdoor wood boiler — **which is the only agreement in the round that counts as two checks.**

_whatTheCorrectnessReviewFound.1_theRealOne: Eight zero-care rulings stated WHO would do the work rather than why no care exists. **A labour fact deciding a care declaration** — pilot §1a applied to fields but not to prose, by its own author. The test that sorts them is **does something need to be scheduled, coordinated or remembered**, never who performs it.
_whatTheCorrectnessReviewFound.howItResolved: **Three gain care** — `gas-shutoff` (a valve needs exercising; `professional` is the audience, not the reason), `backflow-preventer` and `elevator-lift` (a mandated test somebody must arrange is care). **Two more gain care from plain omission** — `foundation-vent` and `dock-de-icer`, where the seasonal action was written as an owner question and never declared. **Five keep zero and have their reasons rewritten** to state the absence rather than the performer.
_whatTheCorrectnessReviewFound.2_falseAndConfidentlyStated: Its third structural finding — classes with `replacementHorizon: false` still carrying `age-past-band-midpoint` — **is false. Zero classes do this.** It named fifteen. It appears to have inferred the pairing from the two lines sitting near each other in the rendered markdown. **Checked before acting on it**, and worth recording as the shape a review can produce.
_whatTheCorrectnessReviewFound.3_realHazardWronglyLocated: It flagged the bare word *condition* in inspection point labels as inviting a grade. **The hazard is real and the location is wrong** — 48 of 162 labels contain it, not the nine it saw, and an inspection point is not an act a person takes. It names what the binder wants known; Amendment 6. **Where the word actually bites is client-facing render and checklist item text**, neither of which is in this file, and House Style already bans judgement words there. Recorded for the client-names pass, not acted on here.
_whatTheCorrectnessReviewFound.4_clerical: `gas-shutoff` asked where the main WATER shutoff is. Its cleanest catch and a straight copy of the wrong id.
_whatTheCorrectnessReviewFound._source: The correctness pass, given the full content and asked what is wrong rather than what is missing.

_theCompletenessReviewIsNotAnsweredHere: The completeness pass, given class names only to avoid anchoring, made one large structural argument — **the frame under-represents the house itself**: no roof, no cladding, no foundation, no ductwork, no interior distribution piping or wiring. Its sharpest point is that the catalogue already crossed the equipment boundary with Tree, Caulk and grout, Retaining wall and Shoreline protection, **so excluding roofs is inconsistent rather than principled.** That is roughly thirty classes and a scope decision rather than a correction. **Routed to the owner, not applied.**

ownerQuestions.label: Do you know where the gas shutoff is?
ownerQuestions.note: Added 2026-08-06 — the class reused the water-shutoff question. Outside review's cleanest catch and a straight clerical error.

careCategories.label: Regulatory testing
careCategories.note: A mandated recurring test performed by a licensed party, producing a record. Backflow preventers and lifts. **It is care because somebody must arrange it and remember when** — not because of who performs it. Added 2026-08-06 from outside review.

careCategories.label: Seasonal position change
careCategories.note: Opened in spring and closed in autumn, or the reverse. Foundation vents. Care that changes a thing's state without servicing it. Added 2026-08-06.

_modifiedCareCategories.note: Sacrificial anode. Consumable — §1b part identity.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Descaling
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Scale removal from a heat exchanger.

_modifiedCareCategories.note: Shared with HVAC and appliances. Consumable — §1b.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Condensate drain service
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Shared with HVAC.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Burner and combustion service
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Shared with heating. Schedule caution: combustion equipment by certified trades only.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Valve exercise
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Operating a valve so it does not seize. Shared with plumbing and fuel.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Well disinfection
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Schedule caution: no shock chlorination in the seven days before sampling — it invalidates the result.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Brine tank service
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Salt bridging and residue. Distinct from replenishment.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Water filter cartridge replacement
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Consumable — §1b. A wrong cartridge costs a trip.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: UV lamp replacement
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Consumable — §1b. A spent lamp keeps glowing, which is the whole reason this is care and not inspection.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Quartz sleeve cleaning
_modifiedCareCategories.note: A different part from the lamp, and therefore a different category.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Membrane replacement
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Consumable — §1b. Years, not months; different rhythm from the cartridges.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Tank pump-out
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Also the access event that gates the tank interior — see `accessEvent: septic-pump-out`.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Coil cleaning
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Condenser and evaporator coils. Shared across cooling, heat pumps and dehumidification.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Blower and fan cleaning
_modifiedCareCategories.note: A fouled squirrel cage is not a dirty filter — distinct work, distinct rhythm.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Chimney sweeping
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Also the access event gating the liner and creosote points — see `accessEvent: chimney-sweep`.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Burn pot and ash service
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Wood and pellet. Frequent, owner-level, and the item most likely to be skipped in February.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Evaporator pad replacement
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Consumable — §1b part identity.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Oil filter replacement
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Consumable — §1b part identity.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Radiator bleeding
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Seasonal, owner-level, and the reason a cold radiator is usually not a failed boiler.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Damper and louvre service
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Louvres seize long before anyone notices, because nobody looks in the season they are not used.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Ground loop fluid service
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Antifreeze concentration and loop pressure. Ground-source only.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Generator exercise run
_modifiedCareCategories.note: The one care item in this system that is not licensed work — running a machine, not altering a circuit.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Engine oil and filter service
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Standby and portable generators. Consumable — §1b part identity.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Battery replacement
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Consumable — §1b. Shared with safety devices and controls.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Stored fuel rotation
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Portable generators only. Fuel that sat two winters is why the generator does not start in the outage it was bought for.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Panel surface cleaning
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Solar. Height work, which the owner ruled is HouseSteady labour.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Connector cleaning
_modifiedCareCategories.note: EV charging handles and their contacts.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Door seal cleaning
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Household-level, frequent, and it is what makes a gasket last. Shared across refrigeration, dishwashers and front-load washers.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Grease filter cleaning
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Household-level and monthly in a kitchen that cooks.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Charcoal filter replacement
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Recirculating hoods. Consumable — §1b part identity. Nobody replaces it, which is why it is declared.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Lint and duct clearing
_modifiedCareCategories.note: The dryer duct's whole reason for existing as a class.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Drum and gasket service
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Front-load washers. Leaving the door ajar is half of it and costs nothing.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Appliance descaling
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Dishwashers and kettles in hard water. Distinct from `descale`, which is a heat exchanger.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Interior cleaning
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Household-level. Ovens, refrigerators, microwaves — the care that keeps a thing working rather than merely clean.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Glass and surface care
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Smooth-top ranges and cooktops need a specific cleaner and a scraper; the wrong one scratches. Also gas fireplace glass.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Drip pan replacement
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Coil ranges and cooktops. Consumable — §1b, and the part number is why the coil-versus-smooth split earns itself.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Appliance condenser coil cleaning
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Refrigeration. Distinct from `coil-cleaning`, which is an HVAC coil in an airstream.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Bag and filter service
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Central vacuum.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Seasonal removal and reinstallation
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Pulled before ice and returned after. Lake intakes and floating docks — a whole category the first four systems missed because it is care that happens to a thing rather than on it.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Drain filter or trap cleaning
_modifiedCareCategories.note: A debris trap in a drain path — a dishwasher filter, a front-load washer pump trap. Owner-accessible on most models, neglected on nearly all. Added 2026-08-05 from outside review.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Running the appliance's own cleaning cycle
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Tub-clean, clean-washer, self-clean oven. Distinct from `interior-cleaning`: this is the appliance cleaning itself on a rhythm somebody has to remember, which is why it is the one that gets skipped. Added 2026-08-05.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Manual defrosting
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Non-frost-free freezers and refrigerators. Chest freezers are common in rural stock. Added 2026-08-05.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Exterior vent termination clearing
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Snow, ice, nests, leaves, and a backdraft damper that must move freely. Cross-system — dryers, range hoods, and bathroom fans when interior is written. Added 2026-08-05; the frame had the inspection point and not the task.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Seasonal draining
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Standard hose bibs, irrigation, seasonal lines. Care that must happen before a date rather than on an interval — and the date is set by the weather, not the calendar.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Trap priming
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Pouring water into a seldom-used drain so its trap does not dry and admit sewer gas. Household work, costs nothing, and nobody does it.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Drain clearing
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Hair, grease and debris from an accessible trap or strainer — not a snaking job.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Aerator and showerhead descaling
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Hard water in a limestone region. Household work with a visible result.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Pump basin clearing
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Silt, gravel and debris from a sump or ejector basin. Cleared, the pump lasts; uncleared, the impeller does not.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Eavestrough and downspout clearing
_modifiedCareCategories.note: The group-buy item — seasonal, universal, and height work, which the owner ruled 2026-08-05 is HouseSteady labour.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Weatherseal and caulk renewal
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Doors, windows, penetrations. Household-level and the highest-return small task in the envelope.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Track and roller service
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Sliding patio doors and garage doors. Cleaned and lubricated, not adjusted — spring adjustment is a trade's.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Hardware lubrication
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Hinges, latches, locks, operators. Cheap, and it is what stops a window being painted shut by neglect.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Deck sealing or staining
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Wood only. The composite split exists to declare that this does NOT apply.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Surface washing
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Composite decking, siding, walkways. Cleaned rather than treated.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Vegetation clearance
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Keeping growth off structures, terminations, beds and walls. The care that is mostly about what you cut back.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Seasonal blow-out
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Irrigation lines before freezing. A hard date in this climate, not an interval.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Water chemistry management
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Pools and hot tubs. Frequent, household-level, and the whole of what keeps the equipment alive.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Filter and basket cleaning
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Pool and hot tub skimmers, pumps and cartridges.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Culvert and drain clearing
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Silt, leaves and ice from culverts, yard drains and catch basins. Rural essential — the driveway washes out when it is skipped.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Sanitising
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Water coolers, ice makers, instant-hot dispensers. Standing water at room temperature — the care nobody does because nothing looks wrong.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Firmware and account review
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Smart devices. A camera on abandoned firmware and an account nobody can log into are both failures, and neither is visible in the house.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Blade cleaning and seasonal direction reversal
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Ceiling fans. The reversal is a real seasonal item and almost nobody does it.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Caulk and grout renewal
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Not mechanical, and it is what stands between a shower and rot in the wall cavity.

_modifiedCareCategories.label: Monitoring contract review
_modifiedCareCategories.note: Security panels. The contract is the thing that fails, not the panel.

_modifiedClasses.label: Propane tank
_modifiedClasses.note: Usually leased, and the lease is a fact worth carrying — `owned-or-rented` does the same job here it does for a rented water heater. Zero care is a ruling: nothing recurring has to be scheduled or remembered. Whatever the supplier does on refill happens without anyone arranging it.

_modifiedClasses.label: Oil tank
_modifiedClasses.note: Insurance-relevant rather than merely condition-relevant. Age and type drive coverage, which is why the opportunity fires on age rather than on a finding. Zero care is a ruling: a tank shell has no recurring service. It is inspected, and it is replaced when inspection says so.

_modifiedClasses.label: Propane regulator
_modifiedClasses.note: Zero care is a ruling: a regulator is inspected and replaced on a horizon, with nothing recurring in between.

_modifiedClasses.label: Electrical panel
_modifiedClasses.note: Zero care categories, and that is the ruling rather than an omission: every act that would maintain a panel is licensed electrical work. Three of its four inspection points are the whole of what can be honestly said from outside the enclosure, and the fourth is access-gated on an electrician already being there. Zero care is a ruling: nothing about a residential panel is done on a rhythm. Everything it needs is a repair fired by a finding.

_modifiedClasses.label: Service mast and meter base
_modifiedClasses.note: Exposed to trees, ice and storms on rural lots while the interior panel is untouched. Regional. Zero care is a ruling: a mast and meter base have no recurring service at all. They are looked at, and a fault is a repair rather than a rhythm.

_modifiedClasses.label: Gas shutoff
_modifiedClasses.note: CORRECTED 2026-08-06 by outside review. It declared zero care and the stated reason was that HouseSteady labour cannot touch gas — **which is a labour fact deciding a care declaration, and the class list assigns no labour.** A gas shutoff needs exercising; who may do it is the `audience` field's job and the answer is `professional`. First real use of Amendment 8, and it arrived as a correction rather than as a feature. Superseded reason, kept because the correction is evidence of it: Inspected and labelled, never operated. HouseSteady labour cannot touch gas at all, per the owner 2026-08-05, and exercising a gas valve is not an exception to that.

_modifiedClasses.label: Foundation vent
_modifiedClasses.note: CORRECTED 2026-08-06. Seasonal open and close was written as an owner question and never as care, so the frame asked about it and never generated it. Superseded reason, kept because the correction is evidence of it: Seasonal open and close. Seized, or left wrong for the season, invites freeze damage one way and pests the other. No horizon. Regional pass, same day: exterior crawlspace venting is a cold-climate hazard here, so the class also carries an opportunity to seal. Care describes the practice; the opportunity corrects it.

_modifiedClasses.label: Dock de-icer
_modifiedClasses.note: CORRECTED 2026-08-06. Same shape as the foundation vent — the seasonal action was asked of the household and never declared. Superseded reason, kept because the correction is evidence of it: A bubbler is neither dock hardware nor irrigation, and it runs unattended all winter doing the one job nobody checks.

_modifiedClasses.label: Backflow preventer
_modifiedClasses.note: CORRECTED 2026-08-06. It declared zero care because the annual test is a licensed tester's. **Somebody has to arrange it and remember when** — that is care with an audience, not an absence of care. The record stays an inspection point. Superseded reason, kept because the correction is evidence of it: Annual testing is a licensed tester's and produces a certificate. The record is the inspectable thing; the test is not ours. Stub type at v1.11.0.

_modifiedClasses.label: Lift
_modifiedClasses.note: CORRECTED 2026-08-06. Same error as the backflow preventer: a regulated inspection somebody must arrange is care, and the licensed contractor is the audience rather than the reason. Superseded reason, kept because the correction is evidence of it: Inspected under regulation by a licensed contractor. The record is what we hold; the inspection is not ours. Stub type at v1.11.0.

opportunityConditions.label: Vented crawlspace in a freezing climate
opportunityConditions.note: Regional. Current practice here is a sealed, conditioned crawlspace; exterior venting invites frozen pipes. **Added 2026-08-06 because two reviews disagreed about the same class and both were right** — the correctness pass said the seasonal care exists and was undeclared, the regional pass said the practice is wrong for this climate. The care describes what happens; the opportunity carries the correction.

_regionalPassIsTriagedNext: Roughly ten findings, folded into the next delta rather than this one, because this delta's job is to close the deliberate red. **One is folded in here because it questions a change inside this delta** — see `vented-crawlspace-in-freezing-climate`. The rest: sulphur and hydrogen-sulphide treatment · outdoor wood boiler · direct-vent propane space heater · a garburator on a septic property as a load problem · dual-fuel backup on an air-source heat pump · rental agreements extending to furnaces, air conditioners and softeners · pest intrusion as an inspection point across several classes. **Two are blocked on the owner's building-fabric decision** — snow guards on steel roofs, and fieldstone foundations. **And one is structural: the frame assumes a property stays heated year-round**, which seasonal waterfront properties do not, and full winterisation is a property-level event no object class can express.
